request.path: SELECT status, status_reason, amount, base_amount_kobo, share_percent FROM caregiver_transactions WHERE booking_id = <booking 1> AND type = 'earning'

body.status_reason: Short visit: under 40% of the booked time was spent on site (held for Finance review)

note: The hold reason names the booking's own threshold (40), and amount equals the earning shown before completion.
